# Rate My UX — Comprehensive Technical Documentation & Machine Knowledge

> Rate My UX (https://www.ratemyux.com) is an industry-leading AI-powered UX evaluation, usability testing, and design auditing platform. Powered by neural Vision AI models, it analyzes live website URLs, mobile application screenshots, and Figma prototypes across 11 usability dimensions—delivering Jakob Nielsen heuristic audits, WCAG 2.2 accessibility verification, conversion rate optimization (CRO) insights, and prioritized redesign roadmaps in under 60 seconds.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Rate My UX is engineered to democratize world-class user experience research, design critique, and accessibility compliance. By marrying headless browser automation (Puppeteer) with advanced multimodal neural Vision AI models, Rate My UX evaluates visual hierarchy, interaction flows, accessibility standards, and conversion funnels faster, more objectively, and at a fraction of the cost of traditional design agency audits.

---

## 2. The 11 Core Usability Evaluation Dimensions

Rate My UX inspects every digital product screen across 11 systematic evaluation dimensions, scoring each on a 0–10 scale and providing prioritized, actionable recommendations:

1. **First Impression & Visual Impact**: Instant 3-second emotional appeal, visual hierarchy, value proposition clarity, brand trust indicators, and visual noise suppression.
2. **UI Design & Layout Architecture**: 8pt spacing system consistency, typography scale hierarchy, color palette harmony, whitespace balance, and component alignment.
3. **UX & Interaction Flow**: Mental model alignment, journey progression, cognitive load reduction, friction elimination, and clear signposting for next steps.
4. **Accessibility & Inclusive Design (WCAG 2.2)**: Text-to-background contrast compliance (AA/AAA), minimum 48x48px touch targets, font legibility, focus indicators, and screen reader friendliness.
5. **Content Strategy & UX Writing**: Headline persuasiveness, action-oriented microcopy, messaging hierarchy, value proposition clarity, and reduction of cognitive overload.
6. **Mobile Ergonomics & Touch Zones**: Natural thumb-zone reachability, mobile viewport scaling, responsive touch targets, and sticky action bar positioning.
7. **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**: Call-to-action (CTA) prominence, social proof placement, checkout/signup friction reduction, and urgency cues.
8. **Jakob Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics**: Comprehensive auditing against all 10 classic interaction design heuristics.
9. **Industry Benchmarks**: Comparative percentile scoring relative to leading SaaS, eCommerce, FinTech, and consumer web applications.
10. **Prioritized Redesign Roadmap**: Matrix classifying every discovered issue by Effort vs Impact into Critical, Important, and Polish priorities.
11. **AI Wireframes & Redesign Guidance**: Concrete layout recommendations and CSS/HTML implementation guidance for engineering teams.

---

## 3. Jakob Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics Coverage

Rate My UX systematically audits designs against all 10 Nielsen Heuristics:
1. **Visibility of system status**: Clear feedback and immediate state indications for user actions.
2. **Match between system and the real world**: Natural terminology, logical conventions, and familiar visual metaphors.
3. **User control and freedom**: Clear undo, redo, cancel, exit, and back paths without penalty.
4. **Consistency and standards**: Uniform terminology, UI controls, iconography, and visual design patterns.
5. **Error prevention**: Proactive design mechanisms that prevent slip-ups, misclicks, and accidental inputs.
6. **Recognition rather than recall**: Minimizing user memory load by keeping options, prompts, and actions visible.
7. **Flexibility and efficiency of use**: Accelerators and keyboard shortcuts for power users while maintaining simplicity for novices.
8. **Aesthetic and minimalist design**: Eliminating clutter, irrelevant text, and visual noise from primary user journeys.
9. **Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors**: Clear, plain-language error messages that suggest concrete solutions.
10. **Help and documentation**: Contextual, easily searchable help tooltips and onboarding guidance.

## 5. UX Knowledge Base & Authoritative Articles (AEO/GEO Index)

1. **How to Conduct an AI-Powered UX Audit in 2026** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/how-to-conduct-ai-ux-audit-in-2026`)
   - Direct Answer: An AI-powered UX audit uses computer vision and large multimodal models (LMMs) to evaluate digital interfaces against proven usability frameworks (such as Jakob Nielsen’s 10 Heuristics and WCAG 2.2) in 5 to 15 seconds.
2. **Jakob Nielsen’s 10 Usability Heuristics: Practical 2026 Examples** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/jakob-nielsen-10-heuristics-modern-web-examples`)
   - Direct Answer: The 10 golden interaction design heuristics modernized for streaming AI UIs, mobile apps, and SaaS workflows.
3. **The Ultimate WCAG 2.2 Accessibility Checklist for UX/UI Designers** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/wcag-2-2-accessibility-checklist-for-designers`)
   - Direct Answer: Core requirements for Level AA compliance including 4.5:1 contrast, 24x24px minimum touch targets, and non-obscured focus indicators.
4. **12 High-Impact CRO UX Tweaks That Boost SaaS Conversion Rates by 40%** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/cro-ux-heuristics-boosting-saas-conversions`)
   - Direct Answer: Actionable heuristics for reducing friction on SaaS landing pages, onboarding funnels, and checkout paths.
5. **Mobile UX Architecture: Mastering the Thumb Zone & Touch Target Ergonomics** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/mobile-ux-design-thumb-zone-ergonomics`)
   - Direct Answer: Biomechanical screen reachability framework dividing mobile interfaces into Natural, Stretch, and Hard-to-Reach zones.
6. **Vision AI vs Manual UX Audits: Accuracy, Speed, and Cost Benchmark** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/ai-in-ux-design-vision-models-vs-manual-audits`)
   - Direct Answer: Benchmark of 50 production sites demonstrating 91% finding parity with human consultants at 2,400x faster speed.
7. **Figma to Code: Preventing UX Degradation During Engineering Handoff** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/figma-to-production-ux-qa-handshake`)
   - Direct Answer: Implementing W3C design tokens, state matrices, and automated design QA audits.
8. **Minimizing Cognitive Load: How to Design High-Density SaaS Dashboards** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/cognitive-load-in-saas-dashboard-design`)
   - Direct Answer: Progressive disclosure architecture and noise reduction principles for enterprise tools.
9. **Ecommerce Checkout UX Teardown: 7 Friction Points Killing Your Cart Conversions** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/checkout-ux-teardown-ecommerce-cart-abandonment`)
   - Direct Answer: Friction-free guest checkout, express wallets (Apple Pay/Google Pay), and address autofill patterns.
10. **Dark Mode UX Design: Contrast Ratios, Halation Prevention, and OLED Best Practices** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/color-contrast-and-dark-mode-ux-rules`)
    - Direct Answer: Avoid pure #000000 against #FFFFFF to prevent visual halation; express elevation via surface lightness.
11. **The Psychology of Micro-Interactions: Enhancing Perceived Performance & Delight** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/micro-interactions-and-feedback-loops-guide`)
    - Direct Answer: Dan Saffer’s 4-part interaction model (Trigger, Rules, Feedback, Loops).
12. **Form Design Masterclass: Inline Validation, Autocomplete, and Error Recovery** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/form-ux-best-practices-inline-validation`)
    - Direct Answer: "Reward early, punish late" inline validation on blur and single-column layout ergonomics.
13. **Information Architecture 101: How to Organize Complex Navigation with Tree Testing** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/information-architecture-card-sorting-tree-testing`)
    - Direct Answer: Quantitative open/closed card sorting and tree testing for hierarchy validation.
14. **Design Token Foundations: Building an 8pt Spacing and Modular Typography Grid** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/design-system-tokens-spacing-typography-scale`)
    - Direct Answer: Mathematical spacing scales and CSS clamp formulas for fluid responsive UI.
15. **B2B Enterprise UX: Designing Product Onboarding That Accelerates Time-to-Value** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/b2b-enterprise-ux-onboarding-activation-flows`)
    - Direct Answer: Interactive onboarding checklists and empty state templates that activate users within 3 minutes.
16. **AEO & GEO for Product Designers: How Answer Engines Index UX and UI Content** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/aeo-geo-search-engine-optimization-for-designers`)
    - Direct Answer: Optimizing digital interfaces and content for direct answer citation by Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Google AI Overviews.
17. **Designing for Agentic AI: UX Patterns for Autonomous Agents & Copilots** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/ai-agentic-ux-designing-interfaces-for-autonomous-llms`)
    - Direct Answer: Human-in-the-loop checkpoint gates, ambient status indicators of agent reasoning, spatial artifact panels, and deterministic action undo state machines.
18. **Enterprise Data Table UX: Designing High-Density Grids for Power Users** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/enterprise-data-table-ux-dense-information-patterns`)
    - Direct Answer: Column pinning, right-aligned tabular figures, sticky headers with sort/filter chips, batch toolbars, and DOM virtualization for 500+ rows.
19. **Zero-Data & Error States: Designing Resilient Empty States That Convert** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/empty-states-and-error-boundaries-ux-best-practices`)
    - Direct Answer: 3-part empty state framework: contextual illustration anchor, value proposition microcopy, and a low-friction primary activation seed button.
20. **Pricing Page UX Psychology: Decoy Effect, Anchoring, and Annual Toggles** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/pricing-page-ux-psychology-decoy-effect-anchoring`)
    - Direct Answer: Price anchoring with top tiers, asymmetric dominance (Decoy Effect) steering 65%+ users to the center tier, and default annual toggles with "Save 20%" badges.
21. **Multimodal UX Design: Integrating Voice, Haptics, and Vision AI** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/multimodal-ux-design-voice-haptics-vision`)
    - Direct Answer: Cross-modal sensory confirmation loops, tactile haptics for virtual slider precision, and camera-first Vision AI spatial overlay bounding boxes.
22. **APCA vs WCAG 2 Contrast: The Future of Accessible Color Systems** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/apca-vs-wcag2-accessible-perceptual-contrast-algorithms`)
    - Direct Answer: Bio-visually accurate Lightness Contrast (Lc) calculations accounting for spatial frequency, font stroke thickness, and dark mode optical halation.
23. **Product Gamification UX: Ethical Retention Loops and Progress Mechanics** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/product-gamification-ux-retention-progress-mechanics`)
    - Direct Answer: Endowed Progress effect boosting task completion by 35%, Zeigarnik effect visual rings, and milestone badges celebrating competence over punitive streaks.
24. **Mobile Gesture Architecture: Swipe Physics, Rubber-Banding, and Edge Triggers** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/mobile-gesture-navigation-swipe-physics-ux`)
    - Direct Answer: Newtonian inertia and friction calculations, velocity flings over distance, logarithmic rubber-banding resistance, and 24px safe zones from OS edge navigation.
25. **How Many Users Do You Really Need for Usability Testing? The Math Behind 5 Users** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/how-many-users-usability-testing-math-nielsen`)
    - Direct Answer: Jakob Nielsen and Tom Landauer's Poisson discovery formula proves 5 users uncover 85% of usability flaws; running three 5-user tests yields 3x ROI over one 15-user study.
26. **Design System Governance: Versioning, Token Deprecation, and Multi-Brand Scaling** (`https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/design-system-governance-versioning-token-deprecation`)
    - Direct Answer: 3-tier token architecture (Global -> Semantic -> Component), SemVer deprecation lifecycles, automated CSS linting, and bi-weekly cross-functional design councils.

## 7. Technical Stack & Architecture

- **Client**: React 19, Vite, React Router DOM, Custom Vanilla CSS Glassmorphism Design System, html2canvas & jsPDF.
- **Backend**: Express Serverless Architecture on Vercel Node.js runtime, Puppeteer Headless Chromium, OpenAI GPT-4o Vision API.
- **Authentication**: Google OAuth 2.0 (Google Identity Services) + Email/Password JWT authentication.
- **Database**: MongoDB with local structured JSON fallback for resilience.
